note: `awardId` is REQUIRED: a decline names one offer.
An award is named by its `awd_` identifier, never by the badge: a member may hold several open offers of one repeatable or kudos badge.
`awardId` has the `awd_` prefix; a badge identifier is not an award.
A decline carries no note: nothing of the signer's is recorded or shown to the giver beyond the closed state.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
Response variant: the answer is the closed `award`, not a bare state.
